page.overview:
Who is Ynez Corrino?

Princess Ynez Corrino was an independent young princess dealing with the pressures of her responsibility as heir to the Golden Lion Throne.

An independent young princess dealing with the pressures of being heir to the throne, Ynez plans to study with the Sisterhood.

When Ynez was a child, some rebels came into her bedroom to kidnap her. Constantine knew he couldn't stop them, so he told them to take him as well. Their parents covered this up in order to avoid looking weak, meaning no one outside the palace knew about it. It was the first time Ynez was aware of politics.

Ynez was betrothed to Pruwet Richese, who was only nine years old, to unite their two families, giving Ynez's family the resources they needed. Despite the age gap, Ynez told her mother she was satisfied with the pairing as it gave her time to live her life as she wanted while she waited for him to come of age, including training with the Sisterhood to become a Truthsayer.
